$help.how: Copy to content/matches/<key>.json, or let tools/add_match.py create it for you. Fields starting with $ are ignored.
$help.key: File name and URL id: lowercase letters, digits, _ or -. The site opens it at match.html?m=<key>. Convention: g<teams>_<short-name>.
$help.id: Schedule / engine match id (e.g. sz04-m016157). Shown in small print; repeat the key if there is none.
$help.order: Lobby position, low numbers first. Existing matches use 10, 20, 30... add_match.py picks the next free slot.
$help.featured: true puts this match in the lobby hero. Only one match can be featured.
$help.tag: 2-4 word hook shown as a chip. zh 4-10 characters.
$help.title: One line: who won, the score, and the turning point. zh scores use a colon (31:29), en uses an en dash (31–29).
$help.desc: Two or three factual sentences with turn numbers (第 378 回合 / turn 378). Check facts with: python3 tools/build_catalog.py --report
$help.auto: Leave a text field as "auto" (or empty) and add_match.py drafts it from the replay.
